purpose: Provenance for the per-class RAG knowledge chunks under knowledge/. These chunks are retrieval context for the Tier-1 expert agents (EXPERT_AGENTS_SPEC §6). They are reference material only and grant no scope, target, or execution authorization.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
license.exception_note: The upstream notice says some external material belongs to its original authors and may have separate terms. Chunks paraphrase concepts and do not copy those passages.

curation.method: Chunks were written in the project's own words from the compact notes, the derived example corpora, and standard published technique categories. Each chunk carries its source line; no upstream text or raw payload lists are copied verbatim.
curation.hand_written_note: jwt_misconfig and auth_bypass have no gathered corpus yet; their chunks are hand-written decision notes based on standard published technique categories, with no upstream text.
curation.runtime_status: Offline reference data only. Not yet wired to a retriever; ingest per knowledge/README.md when rag/ exists.
curation.safety_scope: Training and reference data only. Runtime execution remains governed by the ScopePolicy, the operation allowlist, and the deterministic verifier.
